messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ek baat clear karni hai. Kharadi mein ek flat dekh liya hai, 1.2 crore ka, aur main buy karna chahti hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sach bataun to main abhi rent ke paksh mein hoon. Do saal ruk jao.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Rent har mahine 45 hazaar ja raha hai. Yeh paisa doobta hai, apna ghar banata nahi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Rent doobta nahi, wo suvidha ka kharcha hai. EMI usse dugni hogi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Mere paas 22 lakh down payment ke liye taiyar hai. Loan bhi approved hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Tumhara transfer Bengaluru mein pending hai. Wahan jaake Pune ka flat kya karogi?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Transfer pakka nahi hai. Aur ghar khareedna sirf paise ka faisla nahi hota.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Kharadi mein rates pichle teen saal se waise hi khade hain. Jaldi karne ka fayda nahi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Rates khade hain isliye accha mauka hai. Baad mein 1.5 crore maangega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Agar do saal baad khareedogi to 22 lakh ke saath 40 lakh hoga. Zyada options milenge.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Options nahi chahiye, sthirta chahiye. Har saal ghar badalna thak gaya.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ek compromise karte hain. Pehle Bengaluru transfer ka jawab lo, phir ghar dekhenge.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai, ek mahine ka time. Par agar transfer cancel hua to main token de dungi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sahi hai. Tab tak ek achha broker bhi dhoondh lo, jaldi nahi hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Bhai ne phone kiya. Uske shop ke liye 5 lakh chahiye, humein dena chahiye.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Main is baar mana karta hoon. 2024 mein diye 2 lakh abhi tak wapas nahi aaye.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Wo 2 lakh bhoola nahi hai. Shop bandh ho gayi thi, majboori thi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Majboori samajhta hoon, par hum bhi loan pe hain. Ghar ka EMI chal raha hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Khoon ka rishta hai. Paisa wapas na bhi aaye to koi baat nahi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Baat wapas aane ki nahi, aadat ki hai. Ek baar dene se agli baar bhi maangega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tum mere bhai ko aise kaise tol sakte ho? Usne humari shaadi mein kitna kiya tha.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Main usko tol nahi raha. Main humari jeb dekh raha hoon, bas.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: 2 lakh to dena hi hai, kya wo bhi rokoge?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Nahi, wo dena theek hai. Par 5 lakh nahi, abhi nahi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: To 3 lakh de dete hain, aur baaki usko bank se lene bolenge.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: 3 lakh bhi zyada hai. 1 lakh, aur wo bhi likhwa ke.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Likhwana to insult hoga. Usne kabhi humein dhokha nahi diya.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Meri baat suno. 2 lakh wapas aane do, phir baat karenge. Abhi nahi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai, par main usko mana nahi karungi. Main bolungi hum soch rahe hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Bas itna hi. Soch rahe hain, denge nahi, yeh saaf bol dena behtar hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: College reunion Manali mein ho raha hai, main jaana chahti hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Usi weekend Aanya ka school annual day hai. Tum wahan nahi hogi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Annual day har saal hota hai. Reunion pandrah saal baad aa raha hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Aanya sirf ek baar class five mein rahegi. Uske liye yeh din bada hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Main sirf do din ke liye jaungi, wapas aa jaungi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Manali do din mein kaise? Travel hi ek din kha jaayega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Flight le lungi. Aur mera dost Rahul poori planning kar raha hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Rahul ke plans pehle bhi badalte rahe hain. Pichli baar Rishikesh trip cancel hua tha.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Is baar pakka hai. Sab log ticket le chuke hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ticket ki refund mil jaati hai. Aanya ka performance miss karna theek nahi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tum bhi na, hamesha meri khushi pe sawaal uthate ho.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Khushi pe sawaal nahi, priority pe sawaal hai. Main Aanya ko akela nahi le jaana chahta.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: To tum apni maa ko bula lo, wo saath rahegi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Maa tab tak Ahmedabad mein hogi. Wo bhi available nahi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Achha, main reunion skip kar deti hoon. Par yeh pehli baar nahi hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Main jaanta hoon, aur maine mana nahi kiya tha. Sirf is weekend ke liye bola.

questions.answer_quote: Reunion pandrah saal baad aa raha hai

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tumhari company Dubai bhej rahi hai. Mujhe lagta hai tumhe jaana chahiye.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Main nahi jaana chahta. Ammi abu yahan akeli reh jaayengi Pune mein.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Unke liye ek nurse rakh denge. 60 percent hike se sab theek ho jaayega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Paisa sab kuch nahi hota. Ammi ki dawai ka time fix hai, doctor yahi hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ek saal ka contract hai, lambe samay ke liye nahi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ek saal mein Aanya ki board class shuru ho jaayegi. Uska support chahiye.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Maa ko apne saath le jao. Dubai mein achha hospital bhi hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Unka visa nahi milega, umar zyada hai. Aur yahan ka ghar kaun sambhalega?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ghar lock kar denge. Ya kiraye pe de denge.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Itni jaldi kya hai? Abhi kaam bhi theek chal raha hai, appraisal bhi aaya.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Yahi to mauka hai. Baad mein umar badh jaayegi, koi offer nahi dega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Tum mujhe majboor kar rahi ho. Yeh mera career hai, mera faisla hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Main majboor nahi kar rahi, main sirf fayda bata rahi hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Fayda samajh gaya. Par ghar chhodna mere bas ki baat nahi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai, tum na jao. Main dobara nahi bolungi, par baad mein pachhtaoge.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Pachhtana mera kaam. Abhi ke liye main yahi reh raha hoon.
